status: Bounded authored diagram-input contracts, not a product registry or universal diagram schema. Rendering code supplies the mappings. Only own-investigram model bindings are exercised here.

state-diagram/0.mapping: States become nodes and transitions become edges; authored labels and qualified guards/effects are shown in the overview and legend. Scope/omissions remain visible; no inferred transitions.

sequence-diagram/0.mapping: Participants, declared order, alternatives and authored event labels map to the sequence. Every state-transition step must resolve through the explicitly bound stateModel; order alone does not imply causation.
